name: Kakosatsu
source:
My engagement to Kyoko who is a sexy, beautiful woman was the greatest moment in my life, but everything's suddenly changed with a message contained in an envelope.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028205.html]DLsite English[/url]]
